messages:
anna-partnerships: Quick sync with HW vendors next Wed 10am PT — propose agenda: availability windows (H100/H200/B200, MI300, Gaudi), marketplace listing timelines, SI integration touchpoints, joint PR cadence. Who from eng/runtime + infra can join?

sam-hw: I can make it. Will ask Nvidia + AMD contacts to join. Suggest adding 'fallback model variants' item.

lucas-sales: FYI customers asking about H200 availability across regions. I'll bring the top 3 asks.

rachel-ops: Can we add 'certification checklist' for marketplace images? Last time that was the blocker.

anna-partnerships: Good call rachel. I'll add 'marketplace cert' and 'security docs for Private' to agenda.

sam-hw: Vendor note — H100 inventory Q4 -> likely capacity constraints; H200 pilot availability target mid-Q2. MI300 factory shipments ramping late Q2. Gaudi availability depends on vendor queue; could be late Q2/early Q3.

anna-partnerships: That helps. For rollout waves I'm thinking:
```
Wave A (pilot): H100 spot + Gaudi test nodes — internal + select SI
Wave B (regional): H200 reserved capacity + MI300 small pools
Wave C (general): full marketplace listings + docs
```
Thoughts?

lucas-sales: Keep Waves A/B short — customers want clear cutoffs. Add 'migration plan' note for SI partners.

rachel-ops: Also need 'autoscaling behaviour' docs, and a cert ETA from marketplace (usually 2–3 weeks once image is submitted).

mike-legal: Heads up — joint announcement legal review needs 5 business days. If PR planned for end of Q2, we need drafts by mid-Q2.

anna-partnerships: OK timeline: meet Wed, finalize vendor commit dates by end of week, draft PR outline by next Tue. Does that align?

sam-hw: Aligns. I'll ask Nvidia/AMD/Intel/Gaudi rep to confirm H100/H200/MI300/Gaudi date windows before EOD Thurs.

calendar-bot: Meeting created — "HW Vendor Roadmap Sync" Wed 2026-05-14 10:00 PT. Guests: anna-partnerships, sam-hw, lucas-sales, rachel-ops, mike-legal, vendor-reps.

lucas-sales: Ping me if vendor reps can't make it; I'll get a recorded update for CS.

anna-partnerships: Thanks. Pre-reads: I'll drop a short spreadsheet with dates + gating items in the thread by EOD.

sam-hw: Also adding a quick checklist for SI integration: driver support, OS images, network perf tests, Kerberos/KMS support.

rachel-ops: If we plan marketplace waves, can we set soft deadlines for the engineering teams to hand off artifacts (image, docs, tests)? Otherwise cert queue will push us.

anna-partnerships: Agreed — will propose deadlines in the sheet. Quick note: flagging B200 as lower priority for Wave A — limited use cases, recommend Wave B.

sam-hw: Noted.

anna-partnerships: Thanks everyone. I'll post the pre-read and agenda shortly. :thumbsup:
